name: Aritra Chatterjee
title: Data Engineer & System Design Architect
summary: A decade of experience in the domain of Data Engineering, Distributed systems, Databases, Microservices(API Gateway,Event-Driven & Containerisation) and Cloud architecture(AWS & Azure).

bullets: Played a key role in a cloud modernization project, transitioning messaging systems from Azure Service Bus to Confluent Kafka for enhanced performance and real-time capabilities.
Managed data orchestration schedules using Control-M, controlling data pipeline execution and job dependencies for mission-critical Databricks (PySpark) workloads.
Contributed to infrastructure as code (IaC) development with Terraform, provisioning and managing Azure resources including Cosmos DB for database needs and Azure Key Vault for secrets management.
Exposure in KEDA autoscaling for Kubernetes workloads, effectively scaling pods to zero during periods of inactivity and scaling out based on message queues, reducing infrastructure costs.
Exposure with centralized monitoring strategy with Datadog, integrating logs, metrics, and traces from Databricks, Kafka, and Kubernetes to provide comprehensive observability.
Led data platform modernization, migrating legacy COBOL and SAS systems to Python-based pipelines using Databricks and Spark.
Architect and developed a Python-based API using AWS Lambda to automate the clinical approval process for a Merck client, reducing manual overhead.
Increased data pipeline robustness by implementing a CI/CD workflow with Jenkins
Architect an automated data processing framework that ingests JSON templates to dynamically apply Spark transformations on datasets.
Generated structured JSON reports from transformed data, which directly fed predefined Tableau dashboards for business intelligence.
Leveraged a modern tech stack, including Python, Spark, PostgreSQL, Git, AWS S3, and AWS Fargate, for a scalable and reliable solution.
Implemented containerized deployment using Docker on AWS Fargate to ensure portability and automated scalability of the framework.
Built an internal online code compiler supporting 14 languages using the Sphere Engine API, with Flask for URL creation and automated API documentation via Swagger.
Designed and implemented a web-crawling system with the Scrapy framework in Python, scheduling specific domain recrawls via cron jobs, and served results through a Flask-based application.
Improved operational efficiency by 20% by building and automating data-driven dashboards in R Shiny and Python (using Dash) for executive and operational teams.
Led end-to-end data analysis projects, from defining business problems with stakeholders to data collection, statistical modeling, and visualization.

Provided analytical solutions for microeconomics and accountancy, building dynamic Excel models and dashboards for graduate-level projects. Delivered services through online portals(Chegg India), ensuring high-quality, data-driven analysis.
Developed and deployed interactive web applications using R Shiny and Python Dash for various online projects, enhancing data visualization capabilities for clients.
Built an automated survey reporting tool for Accenture by implementing an end-to-end text mining pipeline, including feature engineering and sentiment analysis for qualitative feedback.
Developed and deployed data visualization dashboards using R Shiny and Python Dash, showcasing proficiency in both R and Python for data management and reporting.
Facilitated the Change Management process, coordinating with stakeholders and the Change Advisory Board (CAB) to review and implement IT changes with minimal business disruption.
Conducted root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents to identify underlying problems, which led to service improvement plans and reduced repeat incident
Utilized ITSM tools like BMC and ServiceNow to track, prioritize, and resolve incident, problem, and change tickets.
Authored clear and concise technical documentation of bridge calls, capturing timelines, diagnostic steps, and resolution details for post-incident review and knowledge management.
